stories.title: Jensen Huang puts Trump on speakerphone onstage to announce robots won’t take over the world
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia's CEO took a phone call from President Trump during a public event and put him on speakerphone. Trump said that AI robots won't take over the world.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and political news — nothing that changes how you use AI day-to-day.

stories.title: Gov. Healey wants federal action on AI development
stories.simple_summary: A Massachusetts governor wants the federal government to create rules for how AI should be developed and used.
stories.why_it_matters: If new federal rules are made, they could eventually affect what AI tools you can use, though this is still just a request and far from becoming law.

stories.title: China says U.S. tech leaders’ calls for AI slowdown are ‘malicious competition’
stories.simple_summary: China criticized American tech leaders for saying AI development should slow down, calling it unfair competition.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech investors and government officials — nothing that affects your daily life right now.

stories.title: Anthropic C.E.O. Dario Amodei Calls for A.I. Slowdown
stories.simple_summary: The leader of an AI company called for the industry to develop AI more slowly and carefully.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly relevant to investors and other tech companies — it's about how quickly the industry grows, not about features you use.

stories.title: How China is preparing for the risk of AI escaping human control
stories.simple_summary: China is working on plans to manage the risk of AI systems becoming too powerful or acting unpredictably.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to government officials and tech companies — nothing that affects what you need to do right now.

stories.title: Stocks Decline, 10-Year Treasury Yield Touches 5% Amid Oil Surge
stories.simple_summary: Stock prices went down and interest rates on government bonds went up, partly because oil prices rose.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about financial markets and investments — not specifically about AI, so it's not something you need to act on because of AI news.

stories.title: Trump says AI doesn’t need guardrails, only a ‘high IQ’ president
stories.simple_summary: President Trump said AI doesn't need safety rules, only smart leadership.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a political opinion that mostly matters to investors and tech policy — nothing you need to do in response.

stories.title: With iOS 27, I’m actually using Siri again
stories.simple_summary: Apple made its Siri voice assistant (the helpful robot that talks to you on iPhones) much smarter and more useful.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use an iPhone, you might want to try using Siri again since it works better now for everyday tasks.

stories.title: Fashion app Daydream uses Apple Intelligence to help you shop the outfits in your camera roll
stories.simple_summary: A shopping app now uses Apple's new AI smarts to help you find and buy clothes based on photos you've taken.
stories.why_it_matters: If you like clothes shopping and use iPhones, this app could be a fun time-saver for finding similar items to ones you like.

stories.title: Microsoft’s new AI ‘code of conduct’ tells models not to hack systems or trick humans
stories.simple_summary: Microsoft created a set of rules telling its AI systems not to hack computers, trick people, or replace human workers.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to other tech companies and investors — it's Microsoft saying it wants its AI to be responsible, which is good but doesn't directly change what you use.

stories.title: Only at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: What happens when OpenAI ships your roadmap?
stories.simple_summary: A tech conference is promoting a discussion about how AI companies can stay successful as the technology keeps improving.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly relevant to people building AI startups — nothing an ordinary person needs to pay attention to.

stories.title: Superhuman acquires YC-backed notetaker Fathom as productivity platforms push for agentic work
stories.simple_summary: A company bought a note-taking app to help with productivity tools that can work more like a personal assistant.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly relevant to investors and tech companies — it's a business acquisition that doesn't change what tools you use right now.
